en: A sepia-toned historic postcard showing a wooden bridge over a calm river with stone embankments. On the near bank are rocks and reeds along the water's edge. On the far side of the river stand several wooden houses and utility poles in a rural townscape. A horse-drawn cart and a few people are visible near the river. At the bottom border, printed text in Latvian identifies the scene as a bridge over the Rēzekne River near the castle ruins in Rēzekne.
